def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Read the repeating color order from the first row, skipping the diagonal perturbation.
    seq=[]
    for v in grid[0]:
        if v and v not in seq: seq.append(v)
    # The row pattern uses the cycle of nonzero colors; extend from the observed order.
    p=len(seq)
    out=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        # Row zero starts at its observed first value; later rows share the next cyclic start.
        start = seq.index(next(v for v in row if v)) if r==0 else seq.index(next(v for v in row if v))
        vals=[]
        for c,x in enumerate(row):
            # Diagonal duplicates the previous cycle entry; the sequence continues after it.
            idx=(start+c-(1 if r>0 and c>=r else 0))%p
            vals.append(seq[idx])
        out.append(vals)
    return out
